file:src/billing.rs.rationale: Additional required-read failure handling preserves dirty accounting debt and validates progress before advancing an outbox. Retain the existing billing owner and its focused regressions. Three explanatory lines record the bounded resident-depth gauge; no full accounting cursor scan is reintroduced.

function:src/billing.rs::drain_once.rationale: Required durable metadata decoding and stable-finality failures now stop the same ordered drain transaction instead of treating missing/unreadable state as zero.
function:src/billing.rs::drain_once.source_obligation: Required-read failure preserves outbox checkpoints and attribution

function:src/bootstrap.rs::run.rationale: Explicit shared runtime resources, critical-task policy and typed owner construction add assembly lines at the one composition root. This exception grants no application reverse edge.
function:src/bootstrap.rs::run.source_obligation: Two-runtime resource isolation and critical readiness-exit tests

file:src/fleet.rs.rationale: Fleet resource wiring now retains one runtime task/readiness and clock owner. Existing placement loops remain historical debt under a fixed cap.
file:src/fleet.rs.source_obligation: Runtime task ownership and clock-domain isolation

function:src/fleet.rs::start.rationale: Task/resource ownership and monotonic timing are threaded through the existing startup supervision loop with no additional network boundary.
function:src/fleet.rs::start.source_obligation: Critical-task registration and runtime resource wiring

file:src/history.rs.rationale: Typed fence error classification, shared maintenance admission and required read refusal extend the existing owner; regression tests preserve these mechanisms. R10 also moves the worst-frame history floor into each runtime configuration, validated by different_runtime_body_limits_size_independent_history_floors.

function:src/product.rs::product_entry.rationale: The route match now transports explicit verified account/capability/deployment contexts and delegates typed consumer/watch operations; it performs no owner workflow.
function:src/product.rs::product_entry.source_obligation: No-body-poll and cross-tenant admission matrix; product consumer/watch protocol tests

function:src/product.rs::product_usage.rationale: The existing usage adapter now propagates required durable progress read errors rather than defaulting to zero.
function:src/product.rs::product_usage.source_obligation: Financial required-read failures and exact public usage classification

file:src/registry.rs.owner: Registry validated domain and typed CAS
file:src/registry.rs.rationale: Serving descriptors now validate persisted DTOs and mutation results; typed conflict/uncertain completion preserves conditional metadata. Growth includes corruption/CAS regressions inside the legacy owner.

file:src/rollup.rs.rationale: Fail-closed key/value decoding and atomic checkpoint preparation add required-read/corruption regressions to the existing financial transaction owner.

function:src/rollup.rs::close_month.rationale: Finalization requires every checkpoint and close-key read and validates exact durable values before writing a final month. These checks remain with the atomic decision.

function:src/rollup.rs::rollup_applies_d.rationale: Existing exact financial reconciliation test adapts to required state/finality reads without removing its original assertions or scenario.
function:src/rollup.rs::rollup_applies_d.source_obligation: Exact monthly delta application and close replay assertions

file:src/shard.rs.rationale: Retained actor protocol and one batch commit owner now use validated tails, typed after-commit replies and bounded accounting pages. Most growth is direct corruption, read-failure and real remote-frontier regressions; no new responsibility is granted by this cap.
file:src/shard.rs.source_obligation: R03 group failure/fence publication; R09 bounded page accounting; R12 tail corruption; R13 accounting read failures

function:src/shard.rs::start.rationale: The shared runtime maintenance controller and typed transaction publication are explicitly constructed at engine startup.
function:src/shard.rs::start.source_obligation: Two-runtime isolation and committer startup/readiness tests

function:src/shard.rs::commit_group.rationale: One atomic transaction still orders append/queue/close/fence storage effects. Typed prepared states and a single publication plan remove booleans and poison-prone temporary success replies; retained match arms remain explicit transaction debt instead of an arbitrary helper split. This fixed ceiling requires separate review for future growth.

file:src/sse/feed.rs.rationale: Two lines adapt the explicit ReadService capability. Existing feed state machine/test body is retained under the historical fixed budget; HTTP/product dependencies remain forbidden.
file:src/sse/feed.rs.source_obligation: Shared feed reads, rollback and source failure typed outcome tests

file:src/sse/session.rs.rationale: Two lines adapt service wiring. This file remains an explicitly declared wire/session adapter, while feed/source/registry/service/budget core files have zero transport dependency allowance.
